command: date -u; date; cat /etc/timezone; timedatectl 2>/dev/null | head -6; cat /proc/uptime
for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do e=$(readlink $p/exe 2>/dev/null) && printf "%s\t%s\t%s\n" "${p#/proc/}" "$e" "$(sha256sum $p/exe 2>/dev/null | cut -d" " -f1)"; done | sort -n
ip -d -br link; echo; ip -br addr; echo; ip route; echo; ip neigh
systemctl list-timers --all --no-pager; echo; ls -la /var/spool/cron/crontabs; for f in /var/spool/cron/crontabs/*; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done; echo; cat /etc/crontab; ls -la /etc/cron.d
findmnt -l; echo; df -h; echo; lsblk -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINT,UUID

getent passwd | awk -F: "\$3>=1000 || \$3==0"; echo; getent group | grep -E "clinical|billing|sudo|disabled-users"; echo; for u in $(getent passwd | awk -F: "\$3>=1000{print \$1}"); do passwd -S $u; done
for h in /root /home/*; do for k in $h/.ssh/authorized_keys; do [ -f $k ] && { echo "== $k"; ssh-keygen -lf $k; }; done; done; ls -la /root/ir-quarantine 2>/dev/null
for h in /root /home/*; do for f in $h/.bash_history $h/.sh_history; do [ -f $f ] && { echo "== $f"; cat $f; }; done; done; echo "(end)"
